mcp.discovery: Enabled tool metadata searched for XTend capabilities at task start

decisions: Use the framework RAM cache and native PageClient history/generation lifecycle; Search owns identity and epoch policy through App Services.
Keep compiled artifacts for projection; cache only completed result JSON, never SSR/resume data.
Metadata health calls have no provider dispatch and carry no search inputs.
Preserve old approvals and guard deadlines; do not automatically grant DDG knowledge.
Use one recovery lease for engine/capability and shared native/provider scopes.
0.9 enforces allowedOrigins for AppServices; pass the configured origin explicitly.
Dogfooding exposed an uninterned initial-resume transport; repaired upstream with a strict initial-only compact graph codec.
Keep SearXNG core pinned; extend only private adapters and offline fixtures.
Lease cleanup persists the current health object after concurrent administrative reviews; a regression asserts the newer quarantine survives storage and cleanup.
privacy: No real search inputs, result URLs, secrets or browser resource keys are recorded in this report.
